topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes and outlines the learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor viruses and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the historical study of tumor viruses revealed cellular oncogenes and led to laboratory assays for measuring cell transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenic and tumor-suppressor mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer-associated mutations are categorized and how alterations in oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes disrupt cellular regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms of genetic instability and multistep tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the molecular causes and cellular forms of genetic instability and explain how they drive the multistep progression of tumors.

topics.label: Hereditary cancer predisposition and tumor maintenance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development and explore whether genetic instability is required for maintaining malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, offers to answer questions, and recommends reading material.
